deficits.evidence: No separate footway; pedestrians are walking on the cobblestone carriageway.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a paved footway on the left side to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: No separate footway; the right side of the street is built up with no space for pedestrians.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a paved footway on the right side to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the residential nature and the narrowness of the street, but no crossing facility is present.
deficits.suggestion: Install a raised pedestrian crossing to provide a safe and visible place for people to cross the street.

ratings.reason: The street is too narrow to add footways without removing the carriageway or demolishing buildings.
The right side is bordered by building walls, making footway construction impossible.
A raised crossing is feasible, though the suggestion is generic.
